entry.title: Outdoor Voices inks licensing deal for UK and EU
entry.summary: The activewear lifestyle brand is partnering with Focus Brands to expand into new markets, with an initial focus on wholesale and e-commerce.

entry.title: Wayfair notches ‘strongest quarter of growth’ since the pandemic
entry.summary: The retailer posted nearly 10% revenue gains and 4.7% growth in active customers in Q3, even as consumer spending habits change in the home category.

entry.title: Google makes big plans for wallet
entry.summary: The tech giant thinks a digital wallet should act as a repository for receipts, track online orders and arrange refunds, among other tasks.

entry.title: Hydro Flask owner rejects ‘opportunistic’ takeover proposal
entry.summary: Helen of Troy said Empower Brands’ unsolicited offer was timed to exploit a low stock price, which has been partly impacted by U.S. tariff policies.

entry.title: Revolve points to stores’ strengths but won’t rush to expand its fleet
entry.summary: At the apparel retailer’s three locations, its private labels thrive and margins are higher, but it’s “years away” from having an extensive global footprint, co-founder Michael Mente said Tuesday.

entry.title: Ethan Allen CEO out as chair after activist board shakeup
entry.summary: Financier Doug Bergeron, who will be one of the furniture retailer’s new directors, has slammed the company’s leadership for months.

entry.title: E.l.f. Beauty growth driven by innovation, not just pricing power
entry.summary: The company’s Q2 net sales jumped 51%, with industry analysts in awe of its go-to-market capabilities and Rhode brand strength.

entry.title: Ikea leans into events for the holidays
entry.summary: Two locations will feature outdoor markets, while all stores will host holiday events this month. The furniture retailer also expanded its assortment.

entry.title: Amazon adds over 100 Alexa for Shopping functions
entry.summary: New capabilities include managing subscriptions, resolving billing questions, and creating and editing lists and registries.

entry.title: Walmart ramps up Sparky features in time for the holidays
entry.summary: New visual recognition and cart generation capabilities for the AI assistant aim to ease the pain of holiday shopping, both online and in stores.
